name: FOUNDER3-registration-again
note: The bug itself: Founder read off when the account registered, so a player here as a guest since before the cutoff who registered after it holds nothing.

name: FOUNDER3-the-later-stamp
old:
=> Math.min(
  player.registered_at,
  Number.isFinite(player.created_at) ? player.created_at : Infinity,
  Number.isFinite(player.first_played_at) ? player.first_played_at : Infinity,
new:
=> Math.max(
  player.registered_at,
  Number.isFinite(player.created_at) ? player.created_at : -Infinity,
  Number.isFinite(player.first_played_at) ? player.first_played_at : -Infinity,
note: The later of the two stamps is the registration on every real row - the old rule by another road. FOUNDER4 (re-aimed by content): firstPlayed reads first_played_at too, one argument a line.

name: FOUNDER3-no-birth-a-founder
note: A row without a birth stamp read as born at the epoch: every such row a founder, however late it registered. FOUNDER4 (re-aimed by content): firstPlayed reads first_played_at too, one argument a line.

name: FOUNDER3-the-birth-alone
note: A row without a birth stamp compares undefined, and a founder who registered before the cutoff loses it. FOUNDER4 (re-aimed by content): firstPlayed reads first_played_at too, one argument a line.

name: FOUNDER3-first-contact-exclusive
note: A player first seen in the cutoff's own second is outside it.

name: FOUNDER3-the-registered-guard-dropped
note: D1 gives a guest a NULL registered_at and Math.min reads null as 0, so without the guard every guest is a founder.
